title: chore: add Azure keys for dedicated gpt-image-2.5 resources
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `AZURE_MYCELI_PROD_IMG_25_FLARE_SWEDEN_API_KEY` and `AZURE_MYCELI_PROD_IMG_25_SUNBURST_SWEDEN_API_KEY` to Gen dev, staging and production SOPS files for the dedicated Sweden Central resources.
- Includes both names in the generation-secret upload allowlist so the first deployment actually installs them. Existing encrypted secret values are unchanged.
- User explicitly approved both additions to the SOPS files and Cloudflare production, plus the separately pending `WEFT_SELLER_API_KEY` production addition.
- Merge and promote this prerequisite first through `Deploy / Cloudflare production`; verify the bindings before merging and promoting #14890. No routing changes in this PR.
- Verified script syntax, Biome, and encrypted-field comparisons: exactly two added keys per environment, no changed or removed existing values.

gist.headline: Sweden Gets Its Keys
gist.blurb: Two dedicated GPT-Image 2.5 resource keys have been tucked into the generation hive and added to the deployment satchel. The routing garden is unchanged; the new bulbs are simply ready to grow.
gist.summary: Added the two Azure Sweden Central GPT-Image 2.5 resource keys, Flare and Sunburst, to Gen development, staging, and production SOPS configurations and to the generation-secret upload allowlist.
gist.impact: The next Gen deployments can install the dedicated Sweden Central GPT-Image 2.5 credentials consistently across all environments, ready for the follow-up routing work.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy secret-delivery scene: Polli carries two carefully labeled key packets toward a small retro terminal garden in a snowy-yet-warm Sweden Central setting. Two lime-green code-plants named Flare and Sunburst sit beside the terminal, symbolizing provisioned resources awaiting connection rather than a live routing change.
